statement: Hemalurgy can transfer Allomantic or Feruchemical powers; its outcome depends on how and where the spike is used. This does not define a complete binding-point map.
implementation: Canonical SpikeLedger records typed extraction and donor provenance; intentional extraction and source-specific implantation/removal are implemented. Exact point coordinates remain labelled interpretations.

statement: Represent each grant independently and retain its origin. Removing one source preserves unrelated grants. This is a data-model interpretation, not a complete account of spiritweb damage.
implementation: PowerGrant and canonical anatomical leases preserve unrelated grants. Removing an implant revokes only its source; extracting an externally granted power drains the parent spike.

statement: Distinct Allomantic spike sources add to the strongest non-spike base; duplicate records from one source count once. Feruchemy uses the strongest access grant. Exact stacking and technical/effect caps are gameplay interpretations.
implementation: Spiritweb.strength preserves raw grants and source identities. Physical handlers retain effect caps; stronger Feruchemy does not bypass charge costs.

statement: Canonical world ledgers own individual invested assets. Item references never mint charge. Relevant ability, contact and Identity are revalidated; a matching implanted stolen Feruchemical source can authorize its donor key as an explicit interpretation.
implementation: MetalmindLedger, SpikeLedger and FeruchemicalEngine. New recipient-filled minds key to the recipient; removing/draining the matching spike removes donor-key authorization.

statement: New characters begin without powers. Persistent spiritweb/contact/implant equipment survives death as a game policy; active effects do not persist. Hemalurgy can transfer a real donor source; natural power acquisition and broader death balance remain future work.
implementation: Persistent Fabric attachments and transient runtime modes; powered-NPC setup is explicitly administrative.

statement: God metals, a complete canonical anatomy map, advanced constructs, Compounding, Fortune, Connection and unsealed metalmind behavior remain unresolved. Working metal compatibility and point grids are explicit interpretations.
implementation: First physical powers and Hemalurgy transactions exist. Cognitive/Spiritual stolen types retain labelled hooks without claiming their advanced effects are implemented.

statement: The author describes larger metal sources as stronger Push/Pull anchors and small flakes as poor anchors.
implementation: MetalPhysics weakens small grounded item anchors. Exact mass scales and force values are gameplay policies.

statement: Ordinary fuel excludes the invested subset. Integer prepaid costs, a fourfold flare cost, a 1.8 flare strength multiplier, effect caps and transient active modes are implementation policies.
implementation: ReserveLedger, BurnBudget, BurnEngine and AllomancyRuntime. Invested fuel is reserved until Compounding is designed.

statement: The initial Minecraft adaptation uses reciprocal line forces for Steel/Iron, temporary physical attribute modifiers for Pewter, and dark vision plus environmental hearing for Tin. Numeric fatigue, overload, collision damage and complete ordinary-force resistance for invested items are gameplay policies.
implementation: First four Allomantic powers with up to eight selected targets, shared force and combined recoil. Grid/wheel switching and bounded five-sense cues exist. Particle lines, advanced Investiture resistance and savantism remain limited or future work.

statement: Physical Feruchemy uses individual contacted assets, integer charge, up to 75% storing, aggregate tapping up to 400% and superlinear high-rate costs. Numerical effects, capacity, death-retained equipment and carrying profiles are game adaptations.
implementation: Canonical world ledger, transfer revisions, Identity checks, separate Tin senses and source-independent modifier IDs. Identity-free filling, unsealed access and Compounding are not implemented.

statement: The eight alloy ratios are documented gameplay interpretations. Exact and off-ratio batches are distinguished; these numbers are not claimed to be verified universal canon.
implementation: Data-driven alloy recipes with composition and viable/imperfect/invalid outcomes.

statement: One ingot equals nine nuggets, nine hundred measured portions, or nine grams of credited metal. Ore recovery yields and silicon/carbon processing are game abstractions, not real smelting chemistry.
implementation: Integer mass bookkeeping and recipe-conservation tests. Zinc refining credits eight zinc nuggets plus one cadmium nugget.

statement: Non-Allomantic and off-ratio metals are refused by the brewing/drinking path rather than inventing canonical injury values. Drinking transfers fuel without granting access or activating a power.
implementation: Server-side vial validation. Invested slicing and ingestion preserve residual mass, charge and Identity.

statement: Extraction retains 90 percent potency; logarithmic outside decay approaches a nonzero floor, blood slows exposure twentyfold and implantation stops exposure. Rates, curve and world-time accounting are gameplay policies.
implementation: Canonical spike assets preserve original potency, exposure and source tombstones; tooltips are previews. Rejected damage rolls back provisional ownership and held-item escrow.

statement: Twelve stable anatomical points, material compatibility and an explicit dangerous upper-back linchpin hook are game interpretations. The source establishes placement-dependent transfer, not these exact points or a complete construct anatomy.
implementation: BindingPoints evidence catalog and M-H inventory; default-off player extraction additionally requires consent and PvP permission. Implant/contact equipment retention on death is a game policy.

statement: Typed cognition, Connection/Identity, Fortune/destiny and Investiture charge does not imply working memory, social, destiny or arbitrary-power effects. Full construct templates and exceptional nonlethal extraction remain future research.
implementation: StolenPower labels every available vs planned handler in the UI. Aluminum extraction is a destructive spent record, not a transferable nullification power.
